answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 46866 Country: Pakistan Title: Zakat On Savings for some purpose Question: My question is related to zakah. I am saving money from my salary from 10 months by reducing my needs to do some personal work. Is zakah allowed on this saving amount? Please guide. Answer ID: 46866 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1150/749/L=9/1434) If the saving money reaches up to 52.5 tola silver (612.35 gram) and one year passes over it then zakah shall be wajib over it, though you have saved it for your needs. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
